name: Serpent Ward is announced on the totem bar after a bar dismissal and a relog (#13035)
contract: #13035 reports that the Witch Doctor's totem bar shows Serpent Ward 500960 and its timer only for the first
ward: after the ward is dismissed from the bar, later wards of the same spell no longer appear there, even
after a relog. SMSG_TOTEM_CREATED (opcode 1043) carries the zero-based bar slot (byte 0), the summon GUID
(bytes 1 to 8), the duration in milliseconds (byte 9) and the spell (byte 13). This scenario records what
the server sends for a ward summoned after a bar dismissal (CMSG_TOTEM_DESTROYED, opcode 1044) and after a
relog: each new ward must be announced again for slot 0 with spell 500960 and a non-zero duration. Native
totems send this packet from Totem::InitStats, before the summon is added to the world, because the client
links a bar slot only to a unit it has not created yet; the class summon script sent it after the ward was
already visible, so a fresh character never saw the bar. The ward is now announced while it is added to the
world, before its creation reaches the client. The packet order relative to SMSG_UPDATE_OBJECT and whether
the client draws the bar are not observed.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: the first ward is out
SETUP: the first ward is announced on the totem bar
#13035: right-click the Fire totem bar bubble
SETUP: dismissing the bar slot removes the ward
Let the global cooldown expire
Summon a new ward after the dismissal
The new ward is out
#13035: the ward summoned after a dismissal is announced on the totem bar
#13035: the announcement uses bar slot 0
#13035: the announcement carries a duration
#13035: the announcement names Serpent Ward 500960
Dismiss the second ward from the bar
SETUP: the second ward is gone
Let the reloaded character settle
Summon a ward after the relog
The ward summoned after the relog is out
#13035: the ward summoned after the relog is announced on the totem bar
#13035: the post-relog announcement names Serpent Ward 500960
#13035: the post-relog announcement carries a duration
